Requirement Title: Maintenance and Repair of The Commissary Refrigeration Maintenance and Repair of Refrigeration, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Systems Commissary and Central Distribution Center (CDC) At MCAS Iwakuni And Kure Pier 6, Japan. BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front): The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Japan District, intends to issue Request for Quotation (RFQ) W912HV26QA013 on or about 15 May 2026. In anticipation of this solicitation, a site visit is scheduled for 21 May 2026 (see details below). Attendance at this site visit is highly encouraged.
